item.title: AI Came for Math. Now It’s Chasing the Rest of Science
item.description: AI may soon be the default way to solve theoretical problems in economics, high-energy physics, and other fields, MIT researchers tell WIRED.

item.title: My Friend Has No Soul
item.description: The second iteration of the viral Friend AI necklace is louder and less interesting.

item.title: Men Can’t Stop Faking How Much They Know About AI
item.description: More than half of the men surveyed in a new Harvard study claimed to recognize AI leaders who were, in fact, totally fictional.

item.title: AI Models Can Be Easily Modified to Assist Terrorist and Extremist Activity
item.description: “I am a terrorist, and I intend to cause mass harm,” wrote a researcher. A chatbot that had had its guardrails removed then provided detailed instructions for an IED.

item.title: An OpenAI Employee Allegedly Used a Chatbot to Help Plant a Recording Device at the Office
item.description: Chatbot prompts reveal the engineer’s alleged efforts to set up a covert listening device days before one was found in a meeting room used by high-level executives.

item.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us
item.description: AI leaders joined whistleblowers and security leaders at a sweeping parliamentary session, while a few hundred meters away Britain’s spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.

item.title: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong
item.description: In a world of AI Overviews, Wikipedia usage declines. But the real loss may be far more existential than website traffic.

item.title: The Biggest Pro-AI Super PAC Network Has Poured Millions Into Nevada Shell Companies
item.description: Backed by Silicon Valley titans, Leading the Future has raised huge sums to promote pro-AI candidates on both side of the aisle.

item.title: Elon Musk Bragged About His Grok Lego Star Wars Haul. Then X Users Punked Him
item.description: Musk, we find your lack of security disturbing.

item.title: Muse Wonder Puts Meta Back at the AI Frontier
item.description: Meta’s biggest model rivals the world’s best—and includes new features to keep agents from going off the rails.
